goal: Allow querying transaction history by script or address without importing keys into the wallet
Lets node operators and light-wallet servers inspect history without third-party indexer databases
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (sedited, l0rinc, w0xlt)
Concept approval verified by functional and regtest testing (kravens)
Unaddressed objection: queries can exceed disk read budget because block reads are uncounted (kravens)
Unaddressed objection: declaring TxToJSON in a common header violates library layering (kravens)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it provides output indexing requested since 2013 without requiring the internal wallet
Operates within roughly 61 GB of disk space and syncs in hours while supporting pruned nodes

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because getscripthistory lets light-wallet servers query script history directly from the node
Supports lookups across descriptors, raw scripts, and spending transactions with a query budget
